Commentary.Commentary: The hosts still have an upper hand in this contest and their hopes shall be pinned on their ace-bowler, Shakib Al Hasan to rip through. Australia are already under the pump and chasing such a stiff target in deadly spinning conditions won't be easy by any means. With still over 30 overs remaining in the day and two full days to go, a result is a surety. Will we see Bangladesh creating history? Stay tuned as the chase will get underway in a very short while...

So, Australia have wrapped it up quickly after the tea break. The wrecker-in-chief, Nathan Lyon weaved his magic by picking up a 6-fer and was undoubtedly the best of the lot. Ashton Agar got two while Cummins impressed one and all. Bangladesh did a commendable job with the bat as Tamim Iqbal led the way, scoring back-to-back fifties. The skipper contributed to a great effect while Mehedi Hasan in the end swung his bat around to help his side set a target of 265.

OUT! That's the final nail in the coffin! Lyon picks another one and he has bowled tremendously well here! Tosses this one around off, spins into the batsman. Mehedi Hasan skips down the track to go over the top on the leg side. Does not middle it and the ball balloons towards the fielder at deep square leg. Khawaja settles under it and takes a really well-judged catch to send back Mehedi. BANGLADESH ARE ALL OUT FOR 221!
Short outside off, Mehedi stays back and defends it neatly.
Tossed up outside off, Mehedi Hasan prods forward and defends it.
Floated around middle and off, swept towards deep mid-wicket for a single.
Down the leg side, swept towards fine leg for a single.
Floated around off and spinning away, Hasan gets forward but gets beaten by the away spin.
Flat at the stumps, Hasan defends it off the back foot.
Floated around off, spinning away. Hasan fails to defend it.
FOUR! Lucky runs! Flatter outside off, Hasan goes for the cut. Gets it through the slip cordon for a boundary.
Outside off, left alone.
Mustafizur Rahman is the last man in.

OUT! 10th fifer for Nathan Lyon in Tests! Tosses this one around off and the ball spins into the batsman. Islam tries to defend it by coming forward but gets it straight towards the fielder at short leg off the inner half. Handscomb goes low to his right and takes a really fine catch. The replays show that it was a one-handed catch, absolutely superb! Lyon gets his 5th fifer in Asia and has weaved his magic here.
SIX! Over the ropes! Floats it outside off, Islam hangs deep in his crease, trusts his instincts and smacks that over the long on region for half a dozen.
Spinning in from outside off, Islam gets an inside edge onto his pads.
Hasan comes down the track and heaves it towards long on for a single.
The batsman has flicked the ball off his pads.
Quicker around middle, Islam somehow manages to jam it out this time.
Floated outside off, Islam goes for the slog sweep but he misses it completely.
Shorter outside off, Islam cuts fiercely towards the point region. The fielder there dives to his left and stops a certain boundary.
Punched on the off side for a single.
Hasan gets behind the line of the ball to defend it.

Dropped! That could be costly! Short around off, spins away a touch. Mehedi tries to cut and gets the faintest of edge to the keeper. Wade cannot hold onto it and Hasan survives. Australia need to hold onto their chances.
Spinning into the pads, clipped towards the fielder at FSL.
Floated outside off, defended neatly by the batsman.
Short and spinning into the batsman, Islam gets cramped for room but still manages to push it back to the bowler.
Tossed up outside off, driven towards the fielder at covers.
Quicker around off, mistimes his drive towards mid off.
Floated outside off, Islam goes for a big shot on the off side but fails to hit it.
Nathan Lyon to continue from the other end.
Tossed up around off, driven towards the fielder at covers.
Mehedi lunges forward and defends it.

NOT OUT! Fuller around middle and off, Hasan tries to jam it away. Gets an under edge on it and the ball flies towards the fielder at slip who takes it. Smith and co. appeal but the umpire stays undisturbed. The umpire after thinking again asks his partner and refers it upstairs. Indicates the soft signal as not out. Replays show that the ball went on a bounce to Smith at slips.
The umpires have gone upstairs to check for a catch against Mehedi Hasan at slip. The soft signal is not out.
Spinning away from around off, Mehedi Hasan tries to defend but gets beaten completely.
Deep mid-wicket in place.
Fuller around off, clipped through square leg for a single.
Short and wide outside off, punched towards the fielder at point.
The players are back out in the middle. Ashton Agar to bowl to Shafiul Islam first up.
... Day 3, Session 3 ...

A good passage of play for Australia but Bangladesh are still pretty on top in this game. Agreed, they lost wickets in a cluster towards the end of this session but at the same time they have managed to take the lead close to 250. This should boost them all the more as anything above it will be considered as a tough target. The Aussies can't relax and they very well know it. Will it be a matter of time before they come out to bat? Or will the Bangladeshi tail wag and frustrate them further? Come back shortly to find out...
Tossed up outside off, Hasan defends it neatly. THAT'S TEA ON DAY 3!
Fuller around middle and leg, clipped towards the fielder at mid-wicket.
Spinning in from outside off, Hasan fails to clip it through. Gets hit on the thigh pad and the ball dies before rolling on to the stumps.
Fuller around off, Hasan dead bats it this time.
Around middle and leg, Mehedi defends it neatly.
Hasan prods forward and defends it on the off side.

Shorter delivery outside off, Hasan camps back and tries to play the cut but only manages to hit it off the splice. Gets it through the gap between the keeper and the slip fielder. The batsmen run three.
Drifting in from outside off, Islam tries to defend it. Gets an inside edge past the keeper for a single.
Fires a yorker in line of the stumps, Islam digs it out towards the fielder at mid off.
A bit quicker this time, SI camps back and defends it neatly.
Around off and spinning away, Islam lunges forward and blocks it away.
Floated outside off, Shafiul Islam gets behind the line of the ball to defend it towards point.
A bit flat and outside off, Hasan goes back and dabs it wide of the man at backward point to get a couple of runs.
Pitches it outside off, turning down leg, Hasan gets across to sweep but fails to do so.
Fuller on middle, Islam sweeps it towards square leg for a single. It was in the air for a while but no harm done.
Tossed up outside off, turning in sharply with bounce. Islam misses his flick and is hit on the pads. An appeal is raised but it's turned down by the umpire as the height seems to be an issue there.
Outside off, turning in, Islam fails to clip it away and ends up getting an inside edge onto his pads.
Fires it full on off, Shafiul lunges forward and pushes it towards cover.

FOUR! Sweeps and sweeps it fine! Fires it full down the leg side, Hasan makes the most of this wayward delivery by taking it on the full. Gets down and rolls his wrists through fine leg to pick up his third boundary.
Short and turning in sharply, Mehedi goes back to cut but finds the fielder at point.
FOUR! Mehedi Hasan is on the charge! Sinks low to this tossed up ball and slog sweeps it over mid-wicket for back-to-back boundaries. The crowd is right behind him now.
FOUR!  A rank hop which has been clubbed! Mehedi Hasan crouches low and smacks it with a pull over mid-wicket for a boundary.
Floats it up outside off, Hasan leans forward and defends it down.
Around middle and leg, Mehedi goes back and tucks it away on the leg side.
Stifled appeal for LBW! Floated around off, Islam lunges forward to defend but gets an inside edge to his pads. The players appeal a bit and the umpire denies it.

NOT OUT! Nigel Llong has missed that by a margin! Floats this one outside off and spins in a long way. Islam prods forward and tries to defend. Misses it and gets hit on the pads. The ball lobs towards the fielder at short leg and the players start appealing. The umpire raises his finger and Shafiul is quick to ask for the review. Ultra Edge shows that there was no bat involved and then the Ball Tracker is called in action which shows that the ball was going way down leg. So Islam survives the scare and Australia still need 2 more wickets.
Shafiul Islam has gone upstairs to review the LBW decision given against him.
Shafiul gets behind the line of the ball to defend it.
The batsman defends it from within the crease.
Islam gets to the pitch of the ball and defends it.
Shafiul Islam walks out to the middle.

OUT! Lyon strikes again! Seems like the Bangladesh innings is falling apart. Floats this one outside off, spins into the batsman. Sabbir Rahman prods forward in defence. Gets deceived by the inward spin as he manages to glove it. The ball lobs towards Peter Handscomb at short leg, who pouches it with ease and starts appealing. The umpire rules it out and Bangladesh have lost their 8th wicket.
Floated around off, driven towards covers.
Around off, punched towards covers off the back foot.
Mehedi Hasan strides out next.

OUT! Another one bites the dust! Shorter around off, spinning away a touch. Hossain stays in his crease and tries to cut it through. Gets the faintest of under edge on it and Wade pounces on the opportunity by taking a sharp catch. Nasir departs for a golden duck and Australia have struck twice in quick succession.
Nasir Hossain gets a bit forward and defends it neatly.
Around off and spinning away, Nasir fails to push as he gets beaten.
Floated around leg, Hossain prods forward and defends it.
Rahman gets behind the line of the ball to defend it.
Nasir Hossain is the next man in.

OUT! Change of ball does the trick! That's going to hurt! Poor fate! Comes around the wicket and floats this one around off, Rahman cherishes that length and belts it straight down the ground. Lyon gets a hand to it and deflects it onto the stumps. He starts celebrating as he is confident that Rahim had his bat outside the crease. The umpire goes upstairs just to confirm as the Bangladeshi skipper starts walking back to the hut. A good knock comes to an end in a really unlucky manner.
A run out appeal is referred upstairs. Nathan Lyon is confident, Rahim is walking off the field. The umpire takes it upstairs to be safe...
Rahman dances down the track and tries to clip it on the leg side. Fails to clip it through and gets rapped low on his pads.
Around middle and leg, Sabbir sweeps it through the mid-wicket region. Another dive in the deep to save the boundary. A couple is taken.

Gives it a bit of air and bowls this around off, Rahim reverse sweeps it through the backward point region. Agar gives it a chase and puts in a desperate dive to save the boundary. A single is saved by Ashton.
Spinning in from outside off, Rahim stays in his crease and defends it.
Sabbir gets to the pitch of the ball to defend it.
Tossed up outside off, Rahman shoulders his arms to it.
Mushfiqur lunges forward and defends it.
Shorter around off, punched off the back foot towards the fielder at covers.
Eased through mid off for a single.
Rahman stays in his crease and punches it through covers for a single.
Rahim stays in his crease and clips it a bit uppishly towards the fielder at mid-wicket.
Again spinning down the leg side, Mushfiqur defends it ahead of the fielder at short leg.
Spinning in from around off, Rahim defends it on the leg side.
Rahim lunges forward and defends it neatly.
Tossed up around off, cut through point for a single.
The batsman gets to the pitch of the ball and connects. A committed effort by the fielder to save runs for his team.

NOT OUT! That was a desperate review! Floats this one around off, Rahim goes across and tries to sweep it through. Misses it completely and gets hit on the waist. The players appeal and keep on appealing only to get denied by the umpire. After thinking for a while, Smith opts for the review. Ultra Edge shows that there was no edge involved. Time for the Ball Tracker to roll in. It pitched outside off, impact too was outside the line and even the ball was missing the stumps. Complete waste of a review and they are left with none now.
Steven Smith has gone upstairs for an LBW review against Mushfiqur Rahim!
Spinning away from around leg, clipped towards mid-wicket.
Rahim prods forward and defends it neatly.
Shorter around off, dabbed towards backward point.
Fuller into the pads, clipped through square leg for a single.
Floats this around middle and leg, Rahman reaches out to it and blocks it.
The umpires are having a look at the ball and they have finally decided to change it. Can this ball change the fate for Australia?
Rahim gets forward and pushes it towards mid on.
Fuller around middle and leg, clipped towards mid-wicket.
Rahim gets behind the line of the ball to defend it.

Dropped! A really difficult chance but they need to take those! Bad luck Smith! Spinning in from outside off, Mushfiqur stays back and tries to dab it but gets an outside edge to it and the ball flies to the right of the first slip fielder. Steven dives to his right, gets his hand to it but fails to hold onto it. A chance goes down and the batsmen run a couple.
Rahim shuffles and lunges forward to drive through covers for a couple.
Around leg, defended in front of the fielder at short leg.
Around leg, defended off the back foot towards forward short leg.
Rahman lunges forward and pushes it towards covers.
Floated around leg, Rahman prods forward and defends it.
Shorter around off, punched through point for a single.
Tossed up around off, Rahim gets to the pitch of the ball and defends it.
Four Byes! Fires it down the leg side, Rahim fails to paddle sweep it through. Wade fails to get across and stop it as the ball races away to the fine leg fence.
Ashton Agar is called back for a bowl.

Drinks are on the field! A good passage of play for the Aussies as they have scalped two big wickets of the first innings heroes. However, the current pair is continuing to milk the runs as they have already exceeded the lead over 200. Australia would be looking to pick the remaining wickets quickly and restrict them under 250...
Flighted delivery on off, Sabbir Rahman prods forward to block that one out gently.
Fires it full on off, kept out off the front foot.
Drops it short on middle, Mushi goes back and pulls it towards backward square leg for a single.
On middle and leg, flicked towards mid-wicket.
Shimmies down the track and bunts it back to Nathan.

Fuller and nipping back in a touch, worked away towards the man at mid-wicket.
Good comeback ball! Now he bowls a good yorker, on middle and leg. Rahman fails to keep it out as the ball goes off the pads towards square leg. A leg bye taken.

FOUR! Spanked it! Cummins drops it short and offers a bit of width outside off. Sabbir Rahman is too good a player to miss out on opportunities like that. Stands tall, rides the bounce and slaps it over point for a blazing boundary.

Short but down the leg side. SR moves inside the line to clip it away but fails to do so as Wade behind the stumps dives to his left and collects it. Half an appeal for a caught behind which is turned down.
A bit short and outside off, Rahman opens the bat face and dabs it towards the gully fielder.
Fullish ball, angling in on middle. Defended nicely by covering the line.
Flatter delivery outside off, Rahim looks to cut but ends up chopping it towards the keeper.
It is getting a lot more gloomy out there. Rain clouds are hovering all over and the floodlights have also been switched on.
Tossed up on middle, SR looks to defend but gets it off the outer part towards backward point for a single.
Sabbir has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.

FOUR! Shot! Gets into the position early and nails the reverse sweep off the middle of the bat through backward point to find the fence. He is an aggressive batsman by nature and needs to carry on now. The lead goes past 200 now and the huge cheers from the crowd follows.
Fuller around middle and off, Sabbir presses forward to keep it out.
Gets down on one knee and brooms it down to fine leg for a single.
Fullish on off, driven towards wide of the cover fielder. The man there dives to his right and parries it towards mid off.

A loud shout for an LBW! Fuller and angling down leg, Rahim tries clipping it away but misses as the ball goes off the pads towards the off side. Cummins keeps appealing to which the umpire pays no interest. Smith comes ahead and has a word with his mates. They decide not to review. It was a good call as it was going massively down leg. Ed Rainsford on air says, it would have missed another set of stumps too!
Short of a length delivery outside off, the skipper ducks to give some more work to Wade.
Sticks on the back foot and defends it back to Pat.
Walks across a touch to this length delivery and works it with soft hands towards mid on.
Good length ball on off, defended nicely by covering the line.
SIX! Boom! Sees the flight, wears his skates, gets to the pitch of the ball and goes bang over long on for a maximum. He's picked the bones outta that one. 150 up for Bangladesh!
Chop on screams Matthew Wade behind the wickets! Tossed up outside off, turning in with bounce. Rahman looks to cut but gets an inside edge on the back leg.
Goes back and taps it wide of the cover fielder for a brisk single.
Flat and quick on middle, tucked uppishly by Rahman past short leg to get off the mark.
Floats it up on off, Sabbir lunges forward to defend it down into the ground.

A shout for an LBW! Lyon tosses it up outside off, it turns in sharply as Rahim goes back to work it away on the leg side. He misses and the ball goes off his pads past Warner at leg slip. They appeal but nothing from the umpire as it was going down leg. A leg bye taken.
Beautifully bowled! Cummins spears in a perfect pacy yorker at the base of the middle stump. Sabbir does well to bring his willow down in time.
Fuller and angling in on middle and leg, Sabbir Rahman shows the full face of the bat.
Cleverly bowls a cutter and lands it around off, Mushfiqur looks to defend but the change of pace takes the inside edge as the ball dribbles behind square on the leg side for one.
Cummins keeps it on a length and Rahim is quick to bring his bat down and block.
Good length delivery on middle and off, defended by covering the line.
Fuller at the base of the stumps, kept out off the front foot.
Gets back and clips this ball towards deep backward square leg for a single.
Sabbir Rahman is the next man in.

OUT! Got him... Shakib Al Hasan is gone! Loopy delivery outside off, the all-rounder once again dances down the track but the ball turns away a touch this time. However, the batsman still goes through with his inside out shot and that leads to his downfall. Slices it in the air towards extra cover where Cummins backpedals to take a good catch. The Aussies have been right on the money. Bangladesh lead by 186 runs.
Gets forward and pushes it into the cover region.
FOUR! Good use of the feet! Floats it up outside off, Shakib comes down the track and lofts it wide mid off for a boundary.
Flattish delivery outside off, defended off the back foot.
Floated delivery outside off, defended into the ground.
In the channel outside off, MR shoulders his arms to it.
On a length and outside off, Mushfiqur covers the line and defends it off the back foot.
Wide! Bangs in a short ball, on middle and leg. It takes off the deck and Wade behind the stumps leaps to collect it. It was too high for the batsman and hence it's rightly called as a wide.
Pitches it up outside off, driven off the front foot towards mid off.
Length delivery outside off, Rahim taps it in front of point.
Short of a length delivery on middle and leg, Rahim ducks under it.
Fuller delivery on middle and off, Shakib drives it back down the ground towards mid on for a single.
Stays back and defends it back to the bowler.
Tossed up outside off, turning a bit, Rahim makes room and cuts it through backward point for a couple.
Covers the line and keeps it out gently.
Flatter through the air around middle and off, defended from within the crease.
Turning in from a length outside off, Rahim goes back and tucks it with the spin towards short leg.
Fuller ball outside off, Rahim bunts it back to Lyon.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
Bangs in a short ball, angling down the leg side. The batsman is quick to duck under it. Cummins is bowling is heart out.
Fuller and nipping back in a bit, driven towards the fielder at mid on.
Good length delivery on middle and off, Shakib defends it off the back foot.
Fuller ball on off, driven back to the bowler.
Shakib Al Hasan makes his way out to the middle.

OUT! Successful review from Australia! And it's the dangerous Tamim who will have to walk back. What a ball that is from Cummins. Comes steaming in from around the wicket, lands it on a length outside off. The ball shoots off the deck and takes the southpaw by surprise who initially tries to defend but due to the extra bounce he looks to arch back and let it be. The ball goes off something to Wade and Australia appeal for a caught behind. Umpire Aleem Dar shakes his head. Maxwell from covers comes running in and convinces his skipper to take the review. Ultra Edge shows a bit of a spike as the ball went past the gloves. The on-field call has to be reversed. Early success for Australia.
A loud shout for caught behind against Tamim. The umpire turns it down. Australia take the review. Is there are a feather?
Pat Cummins is back into the attack.
Gets forward and pushes it back to the bowler.
Lyon goes around the wicket and floats it up on the stumps. It's defended down into the ground.
Darted on middle and leg, clipped towards mid on.
Around middle and leg, Rahim shuffles across and clips it towards leg slip.
Tossed up delivery outside off, pushed back to the bowler off the front foot.
Loops it up outside off, Iqbal dances down the track and drives it through extra cover. The man from long off mops it up to keep them down to a single.
Nathan Lyon to bowl from the other end.
Goes back to this tossed up ball and tucks it on the bounce towards short leg.
Fuller again on the pads, clipped towards mid-wicket.
Fuller around middle and off, Rahim jams it out back to the bowler.
Once again Usman drags his length back, Tamim camps back and punches it towards sweeper cover for a single.
Short and outside off, Iqbal goes back and punches it towards cover.
Tamim immediately looks to attack the part-timer. Comes down the track but Khawaja smartly pulls his length back and cramps the southpaw for room. It's played back to the bowler.
Welcome back for the post-lunch session. Surprise, surprise. Australia to kick off proceedings with Usman Khawaja. Tamim Iqbal to face the first ball.
... Day 3, Session 2 ...

Australia bowled well but only in patches. Their spinners did get some purchase but they couldn't pitch it consistently in the right areas. To only make matters worse, their front-line pacer, Hazlewood is off the field due to a side strain. With already a lead of 176 runs, the hosts would be looking to swell it to a target as big as possible and bat the visitors out of the game. Will they be able to do so? Join us back for the post-lunch session to find out...

So it's advantage Bangladesh at the break. They didn't start the day the way they would have liked, having lost the nightwatchman Taijul Islam and then Imrul Kayes rather cheaply but have recovered well since then. Australia must have sensed an opening but it just wasn't meant to be. Tamim Iqbal showed sheer temperament and is amidst a vital 66-run stand with his skipper which also happens to be the highest between the two in Tests. The former has a good chance to bag a hundred here while the latter looks solid as well.
Spears in a fuller delivery in line of the stumps, Rahim gets behind the line of the ball to defend it. THAT'S LUNCH ON DAY 3!
Good length delivery outside off, dabbed through the point region for a single.
Shorter delivery outside off, Iqbal stays in his crease to block it.
Fuller around leg, clipped through backward square leg for a single.
Good length delivery around middle and leg, Rahim stays in his crease and defends it on the leg side.
Angles it down the leg side, Rahim lets it through to the keeper.
Pat Cummins to bowl the final over before the lunch break. He has some conversation regarding the field setting with his skipper. A slip, a short leg. Expect some short stuff from him...
Shorter around off, pushed towards mid off.
The batsman has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
Turn, turn, turn! Floats this outside off, Tamim prods forward only to get beaten by the massive away spin.
Quicker outside off, dabbed past the slip fielder for a single.
Floats this around off, Mushfiqur gets to the pitch of the ball and defends it.
Short and spinning in from outside off, punched towards cover-point off the back foot.
Change of ends for Nathan Lyon!

FOUR! Beautiful! Another fuller delivery outside off, Iqbal this time gets to the pitch of the ball and creams it through covers for a boundary. Looked fabulous and that's a costly over from Cummins. 12 runs off it.
Fuller delivery outside off, Iqbal drives it uppishly through covers for a couple.

Four byes! Angling into the batsman from a good length, Tamim Iqbal gets forward to defend. The ball sneaks through the gap between the bat and his body. Even Wade cannot stop it as he only manages a glove to it and the ball races away towards fine leg. Lyon tries to stop it with a dive but fails to keep the ball in play.
Back of a length delivery outside off, Iqbal stays in his crease and guides it towards the fielder at gully.
Full and angling into the stumps, Rahim waits for the ball and clips it in front of square leg for a single.
Angling into the pads, clipped towards fine leg for a single.
Pat Cummins is called back for a bowl.
Quicker and fuller around off, Rahim gets behind the line of the ball to defend it.
Fuller outside off, driven towards long on for a single.

50-run stand comes up between Tamim and Rahim. An important stand between the duo and it is taking the game away from Australia. These two have battled it out really well and look really comfortable out there.
Darts this one in line of the stumps, Tamim Iqbal sweeps it fine through the backward square leg region for a couple.
Tossed up around off, driven towards wide mid off for a single.
Fuller around middle and leg, Rahim drives it towards mid off.
Around off, Rahim defends it off the front foot.
Iqbal gets forward and defends it.
FOUR! Darts this one down the leg side, Iqbal stays in his crease and guides it really fine past the keeper for a boundary. Easy pickings this!
Shorter around off, punched through cover-point for a single.
Sprayed down the leg side, Rahim fails to clip it through.
Rahim gets to the pitch of the ball to defend.

Four byes! That's spun a mile! Spinning in from around off, the ball kicks off the deck and also turns. Beats the batsman who tries to pull and also the keeper and the leg slip fielder. The ball then races away to the fence.

Tossed up around leg, clipped towards the fielder at mid-wicket.
Glenn Maxwell is introduced into the attack. He was the one to break the stand between Tamim and Shakib in the first innings. Can he remove the former again?

Darts this quicker in line of the stumps, Rahim adjusts in the line of the stumps to defend it.

Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
Floats this around off, spinning away. Iqbal thinks of defending it but pulls his bat inside the line to leave it.
Spinning away from around leg, Iqbal camps back and punches it through the mid-wicket region for a couple. 100 up for Bangladesh!
Tamim gets behind the line of the ball to defend it.

Eased towards long off for a single.
Short and wide outside off, Rahim fails to put bat on ball.

Driven towards the fielder at mid off.

Iqbal clips it through the mid-wicket region for a single.

The batsman tries flicking a ball that is down the leg side.

Appeal for a catch! Floats it around middle and off, spinning away. Rahim tries to defend it by staying back. Fails to do it and the ball lobs off the thigh pad to short leg. The players appeal but the umpire is not interested.
Driven through covers for a single.

Huge shout for LBW! Floats it around leg and spinning into the batsman, Rahim chooses to pad it away without offering a stroke. This interests the players as they appeal loud and hard. The umpire is not interested but the Aussies are not happy. They think of a review for quite a while but don't go for it. Replays show that it pitched outside leg. So the umpire was right there and Australia did well not to review it.
Floated around off, Rahim gets to the pitch of the ball and defends it.
Fuller delivery outside off, clipped towards mid-wicket.
Shorter around off, Rahim gets behind the line of the ball to block it.
Fires a yorker in line of the stumps, driven back to the bowler.
Eased through mid on for a single.
Defended off the back foot by the batsman.
The batsman has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
SIX! The best form of defence is attack and Rahim just proves it! Tossed up outside off, Mushfiqur comes down the track and flicks that over the mid-wicket region for a biggie.
Floated outside off, Rahim gets way across to pad it away. A stifled appeal is denied. It was way, way outside off.
Spinning in from outside off, the ball kicks off the deck. Rahim stays in his crease to defend it.
Darts it on the rough outside off, Iqbal gets behind the line of the ball to defend it.
Iqbal camps back and clips it towards the fielder at mid-wicket.
Flatter delivery outside off, defended off the back foot.
Iqbal gets to the pitch of the ball and pushes it towards mid off.
Spills this around leg, clipped through the backward square leg region for a single.
Floated in line of the stumps, Rahim prods forward and defends it.
Time for Drinks!
Darts it on middle and leg, flicked through mid-wicket to collect a couple of runs.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
Turning away from a length outside off, tapped in front of point for a single.
This time winds to play the reverse sweep but misses and wears it on the body.
FOUR! Down the track and away she goes! Dances down the track and lofts it over mid on to pick up a boundary.
Floats it up around middle and off, Rahim defends it by covering the line.
Flighted delivery outside off, driven towards mid off.
Tamim has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.

A bit short and down the leg side, Rahim looks to work it away but fails to do so. The ball rolls towards fine leg as the Aussie skipper goes chasing after it. Does extremely well to pull the back in play. Three byes taken.
Slightly short and outside off, punched off the back foot towards covers for a single.
24th Test fifty for Tamim Iqbal!

FOUR! Shot! Back-to-back fifties for the Bangladeshi veteran! He raises his bat to sink all the cheers that are on offer. Well played! Agar slants it full and outside off, Tamim takes a stride forward and bashes it through backward point for a boundary.
Josh Hazlewood is leaving the field. Not so sure why though. Commentators on air feel that it may be due a to a side strain. Ashton Agar will finish his pending over.
Good length delivery on middle and off, defended from the crease towards mid on.
Rahim goes back to defend but gets an inside edge on the pads.
The batsman has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
Jumps out of the crease does Rahim, wears it on the pads as the ball falls short of the the man at short leg.

An appeal for LBW! Floats it up outside off, Rahim takes a stride forward to defend but the ball grips in and hits him on the pads. They appeal but the impact seems to be outside the line. Oh, replays even show it would have gone over the stumps. In fact, Rahim got an inside edge as well.
Mushfiqur Rahim is the new man in.

OUT! Gone! Imrul Kayes' poor run continues. Lyon drops it on the rough and gets it to bounce and rip away from the batsman. Kayes stays back but doesn't know what to do. It goes off the shoulder of the bat and lobs towards Warner at second slip who takes a safe catch. Steven Smith is all smiles.
Gets forward and pushes it back to the bowler.
Keeps it fuller again, Iqbal covers the line to defend it back towards the bowler.
Good length ball, in that nagging zone. It straightens a bit as Tamim once again plays inside the line.
Fuller delivery on off, the Bangladeshi opener drives it back to the bowler who collects it and mimes a throw. The crowd erupts.
Hazlewood keeps it on a fuller length in the channel outside off. Iqbal lunges forward and glides it with an angled bat towards gully.
Fullish delivery on middle, wristed straight to Khawaja at short  mid-wicket.
Joshy start off from around the wicket and hurls it on a length outside off. Tamim keeps his bat inside the line and lets it be.
Change in bowling now. Josh Hazlewood comes on to bowl.
Loopy delivery outside off, Imrul prods forward and blocks.
Goes back and punches it off the back foot towards cover.
Pitches it on middle, it turns away sharply. Kayes fails to put bat on ball.
Flattish outside off, Iqbal punches it off the back foot towards cover for a single.
A bit too full on off, blocked into the ground.
Drifting in on middle and leg, Kayes clips it towards mid-wicket. Lyon himself runs towards the ball. Tamim at the bowler's end while taking off loses his bat but makes it in at the other end safely.
Fuller outside off, the batsman gets forward to defend but gets it off the inner half back to the bowler.
Fuller delivery, targeting the pads again. Iqbal gets on the front foot and pushes it towards mid on. They think of a single which is not on.
Once again Pat ends up slipping one on the pads, clipped past short leg for a couple of runs.
Length delivery on middle and leg, Tamim stands back and defends it towards the short leg fielder.
Fuller and on the leg stump, Tamim shuffles across to defend it towards the leg side.
Cummins bends his back to hit the deck hard. Gets a good amount of bounce as Tamim ducks under it.
Beautiful delivery! Lands it around off, Kayes is interested in playing but the ball kicks sharply off the deck to beat him.
Lyon keeps it full, gets it to turn away a touch. Kept out watchfully. Needs to be patient here, Lyon.
Floats it up around off, pushed towards cover.
Very full on middle, blocked back to the bowler.
Pitches it on middle, skids off the deck with some bounce. Kayes goes deep in the crease to defend it down.
Tossed up delivery outside off, Imrul takes a stride forward and keeps it out.
Leans forward and drives it straight towards the mid on fielder.
A bit short and angling in on middle, tucked towards the leg side.
Kayes avoids a pair! Length delivery outside off, tapped in front of cover-point for a quick single.
Fuller ball on middle and off, driven past the non-striker for a single as the man from mid on was quick enough to get to the ball.

NOT OUT! The decision stands! Aleem Dar will be the most relieved man considering the way how he's got it wrong on a number of times in this Test. Anyway, Australia waste a review here. Cummins angles in a full length delivery on middle, Tamim looks to flick but seems to have missed it. The ball lobs off something towards gully. They all appeal but the umpire turns it down. Steven Smith opts for the review and Ultra Edge shows there's no bat involved and Ball Tracker shows it to be going over the stumps. Tamim survives a scare.
Australia have referred an LBW decision against Tamim Iqbal. Is it going down leg? Let's wait and find out...
Good length delivery outside off, defended towards the short cover fielder.
Nathan goes flat this time, it's punched off the back foot towards cover.
Once again comes forward but the ball drifts away to take the outside edge but falls short of Handscomb at silly point.
Grips from a length and takes the outside edge which rolls safely towards second slip.
Gives it a decent air and lands it full around off, Imrul Kayes defends it off the outer part of the bat towards silly point.
Floats it up outside off, Kayes presses forward and defends it down.
Imrul Kayes strides out to the middle. Can he avoid a pair?

OUT! Nathan Lyon strikes! He tosses it up around middle, Taijul Islam plays for the turn but the ball skids off the deck and pings him on the pads right in front of the stumps. The Aussies appeal and the finger goes up instantly. It was plumb and like my colleague usually describes it - Islam was a dead duck! He walks back but he has done the job he was sent for. Bangladesh lead by 104 runs.
It's a maiden for Cummins! Fuller ball, a pacy delivery that. Defended back to the bowler solidly.
Angling in on middle and leg, the opener shuffles a touch and works it away towards mid-wicket.
Bangs in a short ball but angles this one down the leg side. Iqbal quickly takes the evasive action to let that one sail over him to the keeper.
Goes fuller this time and serves it outside off, Tamim drives it on the up but finds Maxi at cover-point.
A bit shorter, in the off stump line. Tamim stands tall and then pushes it away towards point.
Back of a length delivery, angling in, Tamim keeps his bat inside the line and lets the ball go past him to Wade.
A bit flatter and outside off, defended towards the second slip fielder.
Tosses it up wider outside off, pushed towards the backward point fielder.
Covers the line and buries it into the ground.
Lunges forward to this tossed up ball and keeps it out.
Beaten! The previous shot gives him confidence and hence he tries to slog against the spin. Gets beaten but luckily for him he didn't drag his back leg out of the crease.
FOUR! Cracked it away! Lyon drops it short and serves ample of width to the nightwatchman who camps back and cuts it through point. The fielder gives it a chase but no stopping that one.
Good length delivery again on middle, worked towards mid on.

FOUR! Bangladesh now lead by 100! It goes off the inner half but Tamim intended to hit it in that zone. Fuller ball, veering on the pads, he gets across and flicks it through mid-wicket. Pierces the gap and picks up his third boundary of the day already.
Pitches it up outside off, Tamim Iqbal once again takes the defensive approach. Gets an inside edge as the ball rolls back on the wicket.
Good length delivery, angling in again, Tamim lunges a touch and offers a straight bat defense.
Fuller and angling in on middle and leg, Iqbal presses across to flick it away.
Fuller on off, Tamim looks to drive it off the front foot but gets it off the inner half back to the bowler.
Fires it full on middle and off, blocked solidly into the ground.
Stays back and glides it towards the fielder at gully.
Gets it to skid off the deck as the batsman defends it towards silly point.
Floated delivery outside off, Taijul presses forward in defense.
Good ball! Pitches it around off, draws Islam forward who obliges. The ball then straightens to beat the outside edge.
Floats it up around off, Taijul makes room and drives it towards short extra cover.
Nathan Lyon to bowl from the other end. A slip, gully and a silly point in place for the nightwatchman.
Marginally ahead of a length and just outside off, the southpaw lunges forward to defend it towards Maxwell at cover-point. A good positive start from the hosts.
On a back of a length on middle and off, defended solidly off the back foot.

FOUR! Deft from Tamim! A bit short and outside off, Iqbal sensibly waits for it and then at the last moment opens the face of the bat to guide it down towards the third man fence to bring up 50 for his side. Used the pace of the bowler there.
Once again it's on a similar length, outside off, Iqbal keeps his bat inside the line and makes another leave.
Angles it in on a back of a length, Tamim looks to poke at it but then keeps his bat inside the line and lets it be.
FOUR! Bangladesh are off and running! Cummins from around the wicket, pitches it up outside off. Iqbal takes the bait as he leans forward and drives it behind point for a boundary to start the day.

It's time to get going. Out walk the players and the umpires. The overnight Bangladesh batsmen - Tamim Iqbal and Taijul Islam are set to resume. Australia to begin with pace. Here comes Pat Cummins steaming in. Two slips for him. Here we go...

The visitors on the other hand will be really thankful to Cummins and Agar who helped them survive ultimate bruises as they were struggling at 144-8. The Aussies need to rattle the Bangladesh batsmen to stay in the contest as the deck is deteriorating every passing minute. A good first session could change the course of the game. Stay tuned!

Hello and a warm welcome to the coverage of the 3rd day of the first Test between Bangladesh and Australia. The hosts have been the dominating lot till now and are on top in this game. A good batting performance today will set the perfect platform for them to script their first ever Test win against Australia.
... Day 3, Session 1 ...

The wicket is expected to break down even more tomorrow and Australia will be the last one to bat on. Anything in excess of 200 or 250 could decide the fate of the match. Let's hope for an exciting battle and more than that the weather to stay the way it has been till now. So don't forget to join us tomorrow morning at 1000 local (0400 GMT) to see what's going to happen next. Until then, it's goodbye from us. Cheers!

When the hosts came out to bat, they had 22 overs to play with and their openers did exceedingly well and could have gone into day 3 unscathed but a brain-fade from Soumya Sarkar gave the much-needed breakthrough to the Aussies. Tamim Iqbal is out there and is looking really comfortable. His side would be hoping that he converts this into a big one. Steven Smith, on the other side, will need to share some inspiring words so that his bowlers come out firing tomorrow morning and give their batters some chance.

End of an intriguing day of Test cricket! A day filled with too much of action, too much drama and too much appeals. In the end it's Bangladesh who are right on top and are effectively 88/1. They did a fabulous job to wrap the Aussie innings and gain a handy 43-run lead, all thanks to their spinners - Shakib and Mehedi. The former in particular was the destroyer-in-chief as he bagged yet another Test five-fer.
Taijul Islam has done his job of surviving the second day as he defends it on the leg side. THAT'S STUMPS ON DAY 2!
Tossed up around off, Taijul defends it on the deck off the splice.
Islam gets behind the line of the ball to defend it.
Sharp turn! Floats this one outside off, Taijul gets forward to defend but only gets beaten by the away turn.
Floated around leg, Taijul defends it just wide of the fielder at forward short leg.
Fires this on the pads, Iqbal nudges it on the leg side for a single.
Fuller on the stumps, Tamim presses forward and blocks it into the ground.
Pushes it quicker through the air around middle and off, defended off the back foot.
Turning in from around off, Islam takes his front foot across and then makes an easy leave.
Iqbal defends it from within the crease.
Usman Khawaja calls for the essentials as he is fielding at silly point.
Tamim drives it towards sweeper cover and picks up a single.
Taijul Islam walks out to fulfill the role of the nightwatchman.

OUT! In the air... gone! Why on earth would you play a shot like that when the day is about to end? Absolutely needless! But what happened to Khawaja there? He's managed to hold onto that one. Coming to the ball, tossed up delivery outside off, Soumya Sarkar jumps out of the crease to go big down the ground but mistimes it high in the air towards long on. Khawaja there, backpedals a touch, keeps his eyes on the ball and tries to take a reverse cup catch. The ball pops out of his hands, he then sticks his left hand out but once again the ball doesn't stick. It then rolls onto his body as he crouches low to take it inches above the ground. Good awareness, he made a simple catch look stunning. Anyway, Sarkar departs. Agar draws first blood.
Drops it short outside off, tapped towards the cover fielder.
Flatter one on middle and off, Iqbal defends it by covering the line.
On middle and off, Tamim presses forward to keep it out.
The batsman has played it to the point region.
Fuller on the stumps, worked wide of mid on for a single.
Gives it a nice loop outside off, Sarkar is solid in defense.
Takes a stride forward and defends it down watchfully.
On middle and off, Iqbal defends it into the ground.
This one bites off the deck as Tamim quickly camps back to defend. The ball goes off the gloves but falls in between forward short leg and leg gully.
Flighted delivery outside off, driven past covers for a couple.
Flattish around middle, defended off the back foot.
Stands back and tucks it towards mid-wicket.
Tossed up ball around middle and off, kept out off the front foot.

Lucky Soumya! How did the bails not get disturbed? A bit short and around middle, Sarkar hangs back to defend but misses as the ball hits his pads and rolls through his legs towards the stumps. It kisses the base of the woodwork but no damage done. The Aussies can't believe their luck. Soumya survives and he will look to make the most of it.
Drops it a bit short on middle and off, Soumya goes back and defends.
Floats it up on off, eased through mid off for a single.
Takes a stride forward and defends it into the ground.
Loopy delivery around middle, straightening a bit, Tamim comes forward to defend but gets an inside edge on the pads.
Darts it around middle and off, Sarkar prods ahead to defend but the ball catches an inside edge on the pads.
Quicker through the air, around leg, clipped towards backward square leg for a single.
Fires it outside off, Tamim goes back and dabs it on the bounce to Steven Smith who collects it on the bounce. Frustration is quite evident on Aussie skipper's face. He wants wickets.
Flighted outside off, Iqbal drives it off the inner half towards mid on.
Loopy outside off, it's bunted back to the bowler.
Full and around off, Tamim takes a stride forward and blocks it out.
Floated around middle and off, Soumya lunges forward and blocks it away.
A bit short around off, Sarkar gets behind the line of the ball to defend.
Fuller around middle and leg, Soumya prods forward and defends it.
That ball has taken the inside edge of the batsman and thudded into his pads.
Tossed up around off, the ball kicks a long way up off the deck. Sarkar is unable to defend it this time.
Short outside off, Sarkar camps back and punches it towards the fielder at point.
Spinning in from outside off, Iqbal gets back and punches it on the leg side.
Bowls this too short and Sarkar camps back and pulls it towards deep square leg along the ground for a single.
Darts this one just outside off, Sarkar defends it neatly.
Floats it outside off, Sarkar shoulders his arms to it.
Wide outside off, chops it through the backward point region for a single.
Shorter and spinning into the batsman, Iqbal camps back and punches it towards the fielder at mid on.
A bit short and spinning away, Sarkar gets behind the line of the ball to defend it.
Angling into the pads, Iqbal clips it through the mid-wicket region for a single.
Gives it a bit of air and pitches it around middle and leg, TI defends it neatly.
Sprays it into the pads, Iqbal defends it on the leg side.
Bowls this around off, Tamim reaches out to the pitch of the ball to defend it.
Floated outside off, Iqbal prods forward and defends it.
Sprays this way outside off, Sarkar covers his stumps and lets the ball through to the keeper.
Bowls this on the rough outside off, Soumya mistimes his drive towards wide mid off.
Bowls this fuller outside off, Sarkar reaches out to it and drives it towards the fielder at covers.
Floated in line of the stumps, swept towards deep square leg for a single.
Fuller around off, reverse swept through backward point for a couple.
Floated outside off, spins in sharply. Iqbal shuffles across and gets his body in between to defend it.
Ashton Agar is introduced into the attack. At the same time, floodlights have been turned on as well.
Quicker around middle, Sarkar nudges it towards the fielder at mid-wicket.
Fires this into the batsman, Sarkar fails to clip it through as he gets rapped on the pads.
Floated outside off, the ball stays low. Sarkar fails to get his bat on it.
Brave leave! Floated just outside off, the ball spins just a bit but Sarkar still chooses to let it through.
Floated around off, spinning away. Sarkar covers his stumps and lets it through.
Floated around off, driven towards mid off.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
Quicker around off, Iqbal pushes it back to the bowler.
Floated full around off, Iqbal leans forward and drives it back towards the bowler.
Short outside off, punched off the back foot towards the fielder at point.
Again short into the batsman, Tamim camps back and punches it towards mid on.
Short and down the leg side, flicked through mid-wicket for a couple.
FOUR! Good shot! Floats this one in line of the stumps, Sarkar is bored waiting as he just launches his flick over the mid-wicket region for a boundary.
Shorter in line of the stumps, Sarkar camps back and defends it.
Sarkar reaches out to the pitch of the ball to defend.
Floats this one around off, Sarkar gets to the pitch of the ball to defend.
Tossed up outside off, driven towards mid off for a single.
Sliding down the leg side, Sarkar clips it towards fine leg for a single.
The batsman has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
Driven towards mid off by the batsman.
FOUR! Moral victory for Australia! Quicker around middle and off, Tamim goes for the push, gets an inside edge on it and the ball rolls away towards fine leg for a boundary.
Tossed up in line of the stumps, Iqbal lunges forward in defence. Gets an inside edge onto his pads. The players appeal but the umpire stays put.
In line of the stumps, Tamim drills it back to the bowler.
Fuller in line of the stumps, driven towards covers.
Shorter around off, spinning away. Sarkar gets behind the line of the ball to defend it.
Iqbal stays deep in his crease and clips it through the mid-wicket region for a single.
Floated fuller around off, TI drives it back to the bowler.
A bit shorter around off, Tamim stays in his crease and pushes it towards point.
Iqbal gets behind the line of the ball to defend it.

Shout for caught behind! Floated around off, Iqbal lunges forward and tries to defend it. Gets beaten as the ball goes through to the keeper who is quick to dislodge the bails. The bowler and the fielders appeal but the umpire is undisturbed. They think of taking the review but decide not to at the last moment. Replays show that the sound was of the bat hitting the ground.
FOUR! Punished! Short and wide outside off, Sarkar cashes on the width and smashes it through the cover-point region for a boundary.
Soumya gets behind the line of the ball to defend it.
Quicker around off, Sarkar flicks it towards the fielder at mid-wicket.
Shorter down the leg side, Iqbal camps back and clips it past the FSL fielder for a single.
Fuller into the pads, flicked through mid-wicket for a couple.
FOUR! Free runs! Sprayed full down the leg side, Tamim Iqbal gets the slightest of willow on it to clip it past the keeper for a boundary.
Spin from both ends now as Glenn Maxwell is introduced into the attack.
Floated outside off, Soumya stands tall and defends it towards the fielder at gully.
The batsman defends it from within the crease.
Floated around off, Soumya gets forward and defends it.
Sarkar stays deep in his crease and defends it neatly.
Sarkar lunges forward to defend. The ball whizzes past the off pole.
Spinning away from outside leg, Sarkar fails to defend it as he gets hit on his body.
First look of spin then, Nathan Lyon is given the ball.
Good length delivery in line of the stumps, Iqbal gets behind the line of the ball to defend it.
Fuller delivery outside off, Iqbal gets forward and defends it.
Short delivery into the batsman, Iqbal ducks underneath it.
Length delivery outside off, pushed towards mid off.
Angling into the hips, Tamim fends it towards square leg.
Good length delivery outside off, defended towards covers.
Length delivery outside off, pushed towards the fielder at mid off.
Angling into the batsman, Sarkar clips it on the leg side.
Comes around the wicket this time, bowls this on a fuller length outside off. Sarkar tries to defend but gets beaten by the away movement.
Short delivery into the batsman, tucked away towards mid-wicket for a single.
Good length delivery outside off, Tamim gets behind the line of the ball to defend it.
Angles it outside off, Iqbal shoulders his arms to it.
Bangs this really short, Sarkar ducks underneath it. The keeper stretches full stretch to get his hand to it.
Length delivery outside off, Sarkar gets forward to defend. Ends up hitting it back to his boot.
Length delivery outside off, Sarkar thinks of pushing at it but gets beaten  by the away movement.
Short delivery into the batsman, Iqbal shuffles and hops a bit to clip it towards fine leg for a single.
Length delivery outside off, Tamim goes across and shoulders his arms to it.
Back of a length delivery outside off, Iqbal stays tall in his crease and defends it.
Good length delivery around off, Sarkar stays in his crease and defends it.

Just when Cummins was about to deliver the ball, Soumya Sarkar for some reason pulls out at the last moment. The bowler is not happy and he lets the batsman know about it. Poor Pat has to go back to his run-up area...
FOUR! First boundary of the innings! Fuller delivery outside off, it's in the zone of the batsman. Sarkar leans a touch and drives it over the cover region for a boundary.
Length delivery around off, Soumya presses forward and punches it towards the fielder at covers.
Spills this way outside off, Sarkar shoulders his arms to it.
Fuller length delivery outside off, Soumya stays in his crease and throws his bat to it but fails to make contact.
Fuller delivery outside off, Sarkar goes for a drive. Gets it towards square leg off the inner half.
Pat Cummins to share the new ball from the other end.
Angles it on a length around middle and off, Iqbal lunges forward and punches it back to the bowler. Hazlewood catches it and mimes a throw at the batsman.
Hurls this way outside off, Tamim lets it through to the keeper.
Another good length delivery outside off, Iqbal shoulders his arms to it.

Stifled appeal for caught behind! Good length delivery outside off, kicks off the deck. Iqbal prods forward in defence and gets completely beaten by the away movement. Wade collects the ball and starts appealing loud and hard. The umpire is not interested in it. Replays show that the bat was no where close to the ball.
Good length delivery outside off, Tamim stays in his crease and defends it.

Angles it down the leg side, Iqbal is happy with the line as he clips it through the backward square leg region. Runs the first one hard so that he can complete the second with ease. Tamim is off the mark.
